summary: Two churches: Sacred Heart in Margaretville and St. Anne's Mission in Andes. Weekend, Thursday and Friday Adoration times agree in all three bulletins, and three Spanish Masses are dated in October. Open: whether the Friday Mass after Adoration gets a time. Confession before Mass and the First Saturday Mass have no definite time and are left out.
